environment.description: AWS Lambda container image deployed via custom ECS-backed runtime adapter with Bottlerocket OS host. Container task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with NO volume mounts, NO tmpfs mounts, and NO EFS attachments. The container's entrypoint is wrapped with a seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented with explicit deny on openat/open for write mode via custom OCI annotation 'org.opencontainers.image.config.seccomp.writepaths=none'). Lambda-equivalent /tmp is NOT provisioned - the adapter maps all /tmp writes to a null sink via overlayfs upperdir pointing to /dev/null mount. CloudWatch logs show periodic 'OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system' from the token cache path. Note: the API Gateway fronting this deployment uses a Cognito authorizer with PKCE flow but the Origin header validation is handled application-side only.

config.api_gateway_authorizer: Cognito with PKCE (but Origin not validated server-side)
